description: Defines the JsonField interface representing a JSON key-value pair with methods for creation, access, and metadata, including immutability and serialization support.

classes.name: JsonField
classes.description: Interface representing a JSON field with methods for creation, retrieval, and metadata checks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new JsonField with specified key and value, optionally with a definition.

methods.name: isValueNonNull
methods.description: Returns a predicate to test if the JsonField's value is not null.

methods.name: getKeyName
methods.description: Retrieves the key name of the JSON field.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the key object of the JSON field.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the JSON field.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves optional metadata definition of the JSON field.

methods.name: isMarkedAs
methods.description: Checks if the field has at least the specified markers.

methods.name: writeKeyAndValue
methods.description: Serializes the key and value into the provided context.
